summary: Generates date, time, countdown, moon, and solar channels as integer units or 0-1 fractional ramps.
key_concepts: Generates channels for year, month, week, day, hour, minute, second, and millisecond as either integer units or 0-1 fractional ramps.
Countdown mode compares a target date from the first input against current time or optional second-input time channels.
Hour Format changes the hour cycle and AM/PM channel behavior, while Hour Adjust offsets the current wall-clock time after it is read.
Start Reference defines the zero year/day/hour/minute basis as either January 1 2000 or TouchDesigner process start.
Solar and moon outputs depend on latitude, longitude, hemisphere, and enabled moon/sun phase, sunrise, sunset, and declination channels.
The operator follows wall-clock time rather than a musical or timeline transport clock.

key_params.name: output
key_params.note: Units, Fractions, or Countdown output mode

key_params.name: houradjust
key_params.note: Offset applied after reading the current time

common_gotchas: Fractions mode outputs 0-1 ramps; Units mode outputs date/time integers.
Countdown mode expects input channels named year, month, day, hour, min, sec, and msec, with missing values defaulting to midnight January 1.
Two-digit countdown years are interpreted relative to the current century convention used by the operator.
Solar channels depend on correct latitude, longitude, and hemisphere settings.
Clock CHOP follows wall-clock date/time, so use Beat, Timer, or Ableton Link CHOP for transport-synced timing.
